definitions.development: the agent ran on the task in an agent or condition development experiment (outcomes observed)
definitions.selection_holdout: the agent ran on the task in a configuration-selection, screening or held-out validation experiment
definitions.other_scored: the task is in another previously scored list (an earlier benchmark evaluation or a scored union) or has an executed run directory on the reference host
definitions.uncertain: documented as used, but no run record exists
definitions.none_known: absent from every registry source: potentially unseen, not verified unseen

manual_sources.evidence: commit 0409ddd: "re-scoring the 80 pilot runs reproduces their eval/ files"; the run records are not in git

local_sources.description: run directory names under the Windows reference host data root

limitations: none_known means potentially unseen: only this repository and the reference host were searched
teammates may have used tasks on other machines without a committed record
model pre-training data may contain the problems (contest dates 2025-01 to 2025-04)
